title: The Queue Equation
equation: Work In Progress = Throughput × Lead Time
hook: Your backlog isn't a hustle problem. It's math.
statement: The pile of unfinished work equals how fast work comes in times how long each piece sits.
explainer: If stuff keeps piling up, there are only two real fixes. Let less in, or move it through faster. Working harder inside the pile doesn't change the math.
sop: Pick one backlog, like orders, tickets, or invoices.
Count how many items are sitting unfinished right now.
Measure Throughput, items done per day, and Lead Time, days per item.
Multiply them and compare to your actual pile.
Cap intake or shorten Lead Time, then recheck in two weeks.
equation_example: You finish 5 orders a day, and each takes 8 days from placed to shipped. 5 × 8 = 40 orders sitting in the pipeline at any moment. Higher throughput or shorter lead time shrinks the pile. Slower work grows it.
question: Count how many unfinished items are sitting in your busiest backlog right now.
closing_statement: Control what comes in and how fast it leaves.
caption:
